These little guys are a simple solution to store multiple firearms in your safe. After installing an adhesive Velcro pad on one side, you can stand your weapon vertically in your safe, slide the stick into your gun barrel, and move the stick upwards until the stick makes contact with the top of your safe. If your safe has a shelf with no Velcro on it, use the other side (either hook or loop) of the Velcro dot to keep the stick in place. This will allow you to fit many more weapons in your safe.
